page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. Operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, this instance provides 2 virtual CPUs mapped to 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, resulting in 2 threads per core. The hardware configuration includes 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not feature local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile characterized by moderate single-core capabilities contrasted with limited multi-core and memory throughput. The single-core performance is rated as average, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1571.88 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1308.0. Single-threaded tasks such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also perform in the average range. However, multi-core and memory-bound operations show significant constraints. The stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 2068.27 and the Geekbench multi-core score of 1575.0 fall into the bottom 10% of tested instances. Memory bandwidth is similarly constrained, with read and write speeds for large blocks registering at 15.65 GB/sec and 13.17 GB/sec respectively.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance represents an entry-level general-purpose resource. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that rely heavily on single-threaded execution rather than parallel processing or high memory throughput. Appropriate workloads include lightweight single-threaded applications, basic text processing, and low-traffic web serving. It is less suitable for database operations, multi-threaded compilation, or large-scale data processing due to the documented bottlenecks in multi-core scaling and memory bandwidth.
